raw_comment:
After looking at this graph, I noticed that it measures the severity of droughts across the United States with the most severe being exceptional drought and the least severe being abnormally dry. The data was collected in October of 2024. I noticed that there are very few areas that are not experiencing drought. The areas with the most drought are in the middle of the country. 
I wonder what causes these droughts. Also, will the drought levels become worse or get better? What did the drought levels look like in the past?
This relates to my community because our area is currently experiencing a drought. This leads to a low water supply, which has a negative impact on things like the environment and agriculture. 
A headline for the graph is “Severe Droughts Across the States”
